top_band: light warm brown wooden tabletop with tea set from row 5 to row 9
evidence: Reading a column through the table body: rows 5-9 form a 5px tall lighter brown tabletop surface (carrying a teapot and cups). Row 9 acts as a distinct front edge before stepping down to the darker brown apron/front face (rows 10-12) and inset legs/under-shadow (rows 13-15), totaling 6 front face rows.

style.evidence: The wood ramp has 6 distinct brown values, the blue teapot has 5 steps, and the cups have 3. Outlines use dark brown and dark blue-grey material tones rather than black, and the tabletop has subtle wood grain clusters matching the Beodeul standard.
